queue.alt: The actual six-campaign intervention queue separates its unreviewed conservative screen from pending input review, names Jordan Reed as owner and provides continuing-review downloads.
queue.caption: The ordinary CLI queue retains an unreviewed conservative screen. Each row names the next review action and carries the same native workflow into the desk; none has been silently accepted.

imported.alt: GIFT-321 opens at Review the changed source records. Evidence and planning both require input review, and the original handoff is not yet established.
imported.caption: Opening the CLI file preserves its exact native history, sources and pending answers. Importing is neither an input review nor an accepted finding.

evidence.alt: The evidence calculation has finished but its finding awaits a separate explicit review; planning waits on that prerequisite.
evidence.caption: Calculating evidence does not accept its finding. Planning can use the interpreted records after Leah reviews and accepts that result.

urgent.alt: The urgent GIFT-321 review prefers the $400 external complete correction, finishing at minute 1,435 before the 1,440 cutoff. Accepting the finding is still separate.
urgent.caption: The opening of the current finding. At minute 1,410, external work can finish by 1,440; the cheaper complete correction is too late. The complete comparison continues below this native crop.

completed.alt: The original handoff is recorded complete after distinct selected-plan, authorization, correction, passed rehearsal and 120-kit handoff records; their retained references appear below.
completed.caption: The authored gate supports the original handoff after the linked actual records are supplied. Recording an assertion does not authenticate it or perform work.

failed.alt: A later failed rehearsal supersedes the earlier positive. The original GIFT-321 handoff is no longer established while both tests and the earlier handoff remain in history.
failed.caption: The latest complete rehearsal record prevents fallback to the earlier positive. The original references and both tests remain in history.

pending.alt: The changed review time is retained as awaiting review, while current planning and the operating choice are stale. The actual browser reports that this large continuing review exceeds localStorage quota.
pending.caption: The native download retains the pending revision. This unmodified sample cannot save its full retained history in browser localStorage; the visible error is a deployment boundary.

ample.alt: The actual ample-window GIFT-320 decision prefers the $300 in-house complete correction at minute 40. The cost-first policy does not pay extra merely for an earlier finish.
ample.caption: The decision brief and preferred row. With an ample window, the same v3 cost-first policy prefers the supported $300 in-house complete correction. The full native comparison continues below this crop.

steps: Actual ordinary CLI queue generated six pending native reviews and conservative screens.
Fresh production React imported GIFT-321 without accepting answers or findings.
Explicit input review, evidence calculation/review, planning calculation/review and exact choice were separate visible actions.
Separate fictional source assertions recorded authorization, correction, fresh ten-minute successful rehearsal and full handoff; the original gate became complete.
A later failed rehearsal withdrew original completion while retaining prior history.
The native pending export reopened exactly in a fresh context; full-history localStorage failed quota while a small draft saved/reopened exactly.
A separate fresh GIFT-320 review established300USD/minute40 under the same v3 cost-first release.
